text.text_excerpt: Who doesn't love to go to a strip club once in a while? You won't get any arguments out of me on that one. This strip club has cheap drink specials on Tuesdays. $2 Tuesdays to be exact. But seriously, DID YOU REALLY COME HERE JUST TO DRINK?!?!?!?! We all know the real reason people come, to see some boobs! They got some good looking girls here and a wide variety to boot. Best of all they are incredibly friendly and make you feel welcome. In short if your trolling around on Bourbon street and looking for a strip club check this place out!

Let me start by saying that I'm not a guy who normally goes to or even really enjoys strip clubs in general (sounds blasphemous, right?). Despite this fact, at some point during my yearly excursion to the Crescent City, I always find myself wandering into Deja Vu. Pros: 1. The lower level of the club is pretty spacious, which allows you to find room away from the stage. 2. Seating is VERY comfortable. 3. It's a nice cool place to stop if you're trying to get out of the sun. 4. Most of the women I've seen there are very attractive. The cons for this place are pretty much in line with any strip club I've been to; so all in all....I've found that in my limited experience that Deja Vu is prob...

As a New Orleans native and one who frequents bourbon street quite often, this is one of my top 5 favorite places to be!! The managers are always on their "A game". The bartenders are quick, friendly and very attractive. Of course, I have my favorites but all the dancers are talented and entertaining ;-) and the drinks are more affordable than some of the other clubs. My hubby and I always spend time with this awesome club and it's great people!!
